title: I made a pixel art rpg/survival about a flame knight who eats his enemies. Feedback welcome!
author: Additional-Cell6948
selftext:
Hi everyone! I’m a Spanish-speaking indie developer and I just released the beta of **Lambucio’s Kingdom**, a pixel art roguelite made in Claude to Godot. 

(Art made with Pixellab, code and translations with Claude.)

You play as a knight with a bottomless appetite. Every enemy you defeat becomes a meal, and every meal makes you stronger, but your stomach has a limit, so you have to manage how much you eat.

* **Arcade:** fast, brutal runs with a score and leaderboard
* **Adventure:** a constellation map with 3 classes and 3 save slots
* Bosses like Peanut Butter, Grape and the giant Pancake Stack King
* Full English and Spanish, switchable from the main menu

It’s free, runs on Windows, Android and in the browser: [https://kiruz1.itch.io/lambucios](https://kiruz1.itch.io/lambucios)

I’d love your feedback, especially on the menus and the difficulty. What would you change? 🥉
